source: Counterfeit Access Device and Computer Fraud and Abuse Act of 1984, Pub. L. 98-473, §2102(a), 98 Stat. 2190
wound_addressed: No federal statute specifically prohibited unauthorized computer access; existing fraud statutes required wire/mail transmission; computer-specific crimes were legally uncertain
design: Criminal-only; narrow scope (government + financial institution computers); no civil cause of action
gap: Commercial computers outside scope; no civil remedy; civil action gap
